sql: with sp(p) as (values ('KXALLSVENSKAN'),('KXARGPREM'),('KXASG'),('KXATP'),('KXBOX'),('KXBRASILEIRO'),('KXBUNDES'),('KXCANPL'),('KXCFP'),('KXCHESS'),('KXCLUBF'),('KXCRICKET'),('KXCS'),('KXDOTA'),('KXECULP'),('KXEPL'),('KXESPORT'),('KXF1'),('KXGOLF'),('KXHEISMAN'),('KXHRDERBY'),('KXIPL'),('KXITF'),('KXKBO'),('KXLALIGA'),('KXLIGAMX'),('KXLIGUE'),('KXLIV'),('KXLOL'),('KXLPGA'),('KXMARCH'),('KXMLB'),('KXMLS'),('KXNASCAR'),('KXNBA'),('KXNCAAB'),('KXNCAABASEBALL'),('KXNCAABB'),('KXNCAAF'),('KXNFL'),('KXNHL'),('KXNPB'),('KXODI'),('KXOLY'),('KXPGA'),('KXPRO'),('KXRYDER'),('KXSB'),('KXSERIEA'),('KXSOCCER'),('KXSTANLEY'),('KXSUPERBOWL'),('KXT20'),('KXTENNIS'),('KXTEST'),('KXUCL'),('KXUFC'),('KXUSOPEN'),('KXWC'),('KXWNBA'),('KXWORLDSERIES'),('KXWTA')), t as (select pt.strategy, pt.market_ticker, pt.status, pt.created_at, m.event_ticker, m.series_ticker, exists(select 1 from sp where upper(m.series_ticker) like sp.p||'%') as is_sport from paper_trades pt join mmsell_settlement_meta m on m.market_ticker = pt.market_ticker where pt.strategy in ('Gmmsell0','Gmmsell1') and m.event_ticker is not null), k as (select strategy, market_ticker, status, created_at, case when is_sport then 'C|'||split_part(substring(event_ticker from position('-' in event_ticker)+1),'-',1) else 'E|'||event_ticker end as ckey from t), per as (select strategy, ckey, count(distinct market_ticker) as n_mkts from k group by strategy, ckey) select strategy, (select count(*) from k k2 where k2.strategy=per.strategy) as trades, count(*) as contests, max(n_mkts) as max_per_contest, count(*) filter (where n_mkts > 1) as contests_over_1, sum(n_mkts) filter (where n_mkts > 1) as mkts_in_multi from per group by strategy order by strategy
